language.name: English
tooltip.shenanigans.raw_ores.slow_smelt: Smelts way slower in a normal furnace now.
tooltip.shenanigans.raw_ores.blast: Use Blast Furnace for faster smelting.
tooltip.shenanigans.item_frames.2: Crouch + Right Click to toggle invisible item frame.
tooltip.shenanigans.clocks.day_cycle: The days are 40 minutes and the nights are 20 minutes!
tooltip.shenanigans.foods.raw: Can only be cooked on a Smoker or Campfire!
tooltip.shenanigans.auroraslanters.ameth: Has a range up to 32 blocks!
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.life_: Makes crops around the lantern grow faster.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.feral: Lights up a giant area around it by spawning sparks. When the area is lit up and enough sparks have been spawned the lantern vanishes.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.love_: Makes nearby mobs fall in love.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.waili: Cries if you get close, screams and applies nausea if you get even closer.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.borea: Slows nearby mobs and players down, also extinguishes burning mobs.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.brill: Turns nearby animals directly into experience.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.wardi: Pushes all living entities except players away.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.conta: Keeps all living entities except the player confined to an area.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.withe: Applies the wither effect in the area around it.
tooltip.shenanigans.arcanelanterns.cloud: Applies the slow fall effect in the area around it.
